name: Malaysia Smelting Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年资料中，公司未公布涉及业务板块扩张、新增、缩减或出售的公告；已披露的公告主要为股息除权安排、年度报告与股东大会事宜以及季度业绩报告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收为637,269,000 MYR，同比增68.2%；净利润为34,018,000 MYR，同比增143.9%。
overview_en: In the 2026 materials, the company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments; the announcements disclosed mainly relate to dividend ex-date arrangements, annual reports and general meetings, and quarterly results. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 637,269,000, up 68.2% year-on-year, and net profit was MYR 34,018,000, up 143.9% year-on-year.
